Lists webhooks installed by a marketplace addon, scoped to addon-token auth. This MCP authenticates with a user API key (X-Api-Key), not an addon installation token, so the addon-scoped webhook list is unreachable.
The plain (type-less) submit-for-user endpoint is not exposed; only clockify_approvals_submit_for_user_with_type is, matching the CLI's own with-type-only approvals surface.
clockify_approvals_resubmit only resubmits the caller's own rejected request; there is no manager-resubmit-for-user tool.
Sets the workspace-wide default cost rate (an org-level financial default), distinct from the per-member/per-task/per-project rate tools that are exposed; not currently modeled as an MCP tool.
Binary file download (the receipt attachment); no MCP tool streams binary file content back to the caller.
Sets the workspace-wide default billable rate; same gap as updateWorkspaceCostRate — no MCP tool for the org-level default.

Binary invoice export (PDF/CSV); same file-output gap as downloadExpenseReceipt.
Bulk-adds limited (guest-tier) users to the workspace; a privileged admin user-provisioning action not currently modeled as an MCP tool.
clockify_projects_create covers plain project creation; creating from an existing template project is not exposed as a separate tool.
Bulk project membership assignment/removal; clockify_projects_set_member_rate only sets an existing member's rate, it does not add or remove membership.
Changes a recurring scheduling assignment's series period; the exposed scheduling tools create/update/delete assignments (including recurring ones) but do not expose this series-period-only PUT.

Per-user scheduling capacity total for one userId; distinct from clockify_scheduling_capacity, which covers the bulk multi-user capacity-totals endpoint (POST assignments/users/totals), not this single-user GET.

Time-off policy list/get/create/update are exposed; deletion is not — matching the pattern of most workspace-config entities where destructive removal of a referenced policy is not currently modeled as an MCP tool.

Manager-created time entry on behalf of another user. clockify_entries_log only creates for the caller; there is no create-for-user tool (read-for-user IS exposed via clockify_entries_list's userId parameter — write-on-behalf-of-another-user is a narrower, more sensitive scope not currently exposed).
Manager-started timer on behalf of another user; same read-exposed/write-not-exposed asymmetry as postWorkspacesWorkspaceIdUserUserIdTimeEntries.
Manager-updated time entry on behalf of another user; same asymmetry as postWorkspacesWorkspaceIdUserUserIdTimeEntries.
Bulk-deletes another user's time entries in one call; clockify_entries_delete only deletes one of the caller's own entries by ID.
Duplicates another user's time entry; no entry-duplication tool exists for self or for-user.
Sets a custom field value on a user entity, distinct from the exposed workspace/project custom-field definition tools (which manage field definitions, not per-user values).
Read-only team-manager hierarchy lookup for a user; no MCP tool queries team/manager structure.
Full webhook delivery-log search. clockify_webhooks_delivery_diagnose exposes status plus the latest log entry as a bounded, redacted diagnosis workflow, but not open-ended log search.
Rotates a webhook's signing secret; a credential-rotation action not currently exposed as an MCP tool.

cliLeafExclusions.reason: Raw REST passthrough taking method+path as runtime CLI arguments (clk115 api GET /workspaces/{id}/tags, etc.); it can reach any operation, so it does not correspond to a single fixed operationId. clockify-sdk-add-mcp-tool-style curation would be dishonest here -- every operation is reachable, none exclusively.
